purpose: Qualify actual image/scanned-PDF local OCR and installed SDK/CLI provenance on authored fixtures; not an OCR accuracy benchmark.

apt.identity_policy: Resolve only these exact versions from authenticated signed indexes, verify every package size/SHA256, extract without maintainer scripts into the owned root; freeze binary/library/model hashes before recognition. Package SHA256 values are observed from signed indexes, not claimed predeclared.

fixtures.comparison: Whitespace-split words must equal the exact authored uppercase words in order; preserve original OCR text. No case folding, fuzzy matching or outcome-based font/task changes.

cases.boundary: installed Python parser with actual Tesseract, two TIFF frames
cases.requires: both exact word sequences, dimensions, frame page1/2, no invented box/confidence, no single-image artifact

cases.boundary: installed Node SDK local provider, authored PNG
cases.requires: exact words, no document page number, real pixel dimensions, exact original image artifact, UTF16 citations/chunks, no invented box/confidence

cases.boundary: installed Node file CLI local provider, image-only PDF
cases.requires: actual raster OCR exact words, real PDF page1/point dimensions, raster provenance and embedded-image artifact, exact citations/chunks, no invented OCR box/confidence
actual exit1, empty stdout, generic LOCAL_PARSE_ERROR, no authored document marker echo
